runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-21 doesn't set any fine for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline. My search of the memo found no penalty or fine for missing that deadline.

The memo does set deadlines. Its consolidated table of actions says each agency must develop and release publicly an agency strategy for removing barriers to the use of AI and advancing agency AI maturity. The table lists the timeframes in a separate row (60 days, 90 days, 90 days, 180 days, ... 270 days, 270 days, 365 days). The extracted text doesn't clearly show which timeframe belongs to the strategy, so I can't confirm that from this passage.

I didn't read every page of the memo, so a penalty provision elsewhere is unlikely but not ruled out.
